description: This file defines the CustomerService class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It provides methods to access and manipulate customer data, acting as a service layer between controllers and data access objects (DAOs). The class includes functions to search customers, get customer counts, and retrieve a customer by ID.

classes.name: CustomerService
classes.description: Service class providing methods for customer data retrieval and management within the OrangeHRM Time plugin.

methods.name: getCustomerDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the CustomerDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: setCustomerDao
methods.description: Sets the CustomerDao instance for this service.

methods.name: searchCustomers
methods.description: Returns an array of Customer objects matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getCustomersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of customers matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer object by its ID, or null if not found.
